translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Aaen John Baptist Fenai
Ieei iiy Kkepas Mwamwaai we iwe kkepesaen Jesus Kristus iwe Naiun Deus.
Erhaepetae reen miniwe profeta Isaiah a foatogitiw pwe,

content.text: “Deus a kkepas, ‘Ngaang ipwene fang tiw naeyi rhooan pweipwogin kkepas me weni mmwoamw pwe epwe noa maeneti ennepoamw.’
Erhai a iyaekkepwas me noan desert we pwe,
oawpwe awenecchera eew aan epwe faaeraeg wooan.’ ”

content: John a no noan desert we, a paptismus me epwan fenai. A aengaeniir aeremas kkewe pwe, “Oawpwe toagun saengi monofitimi nge oawwa paptismus. Ina nge, Deus epwe saeneti noa aaemi monofit.”
Rhooanap we re itto saengi faniuwaen Judea me taeninimwen Jerusalem ra noa reen John. Ra pwuwafayiuw noa aar monofit, nge John a paptismusaar noan pwupwu we Jordan.
John e memmengaag mengaag effeeor saengi iunaen camel, nge pwaanto na aan effeeor saengi ginin maan, nge anan mwongo ina manni neeiin waniwan ina nirhiugiunpweon me honey.
Iwe, a aengaeniir aeremas pwe, “Mwaaen ee epwe wareto me mwiriy ina e taegias saengiaei, ngaang mwo nge ese fin ipwe ppwoarotiw pwe ipwe pwaeisi geeogeeon nokkaan.
Ngaang i paptismus aeginigaemi reen rhaan, nge iiy epwe paptismus aeginigaemi reen Espritu Santus.”
Aan Paptismus me Aan Sessoat Jesus
Ese pwongiy noa mwo nge Jesus a itto me Nazareth noan Galilee pwe epwe paptismus reen John noan rhan pwupwu we Jordan.
Igiwe rhag Jesus a teeotae me noan rhan we, a weri pwe a susu noa naaeng, iwe nge Espritu santus a ittiw wooan nge eweei rhag erhai dove.
Iwe nge eew mangiungiu a ittiw me naaeng a aepesa pwe, “Een naeyi mwaaen aerhaengerhaeng, iye efin tipaei reen.”
Iwe rhag nge Espritu Santus a fangenoa Jesus noan desert we.
A no igiwe noan iugiugiun faaeig raaen nge Saetan a aegina aan soatoni. Iwe a no neeiir maan mwoarho, iwe nge angkenus ra itto tipaengi.
Jesus a Faingiir Faaman Rhooan Fita
Mwirin aaen John toonong noan kanepwus, Jesus a noa Galilee a noa fenaiuw Kkepas Mwamwaai we e itto me reen Deus.
A aepesa pwe, “A itto oatowe, Mweoiun Deus a arapeto. Oawpwe toagun saengi aaemi monofit nge oawwa niugiuw Kkepas Mwamwaai een.”
Igiwe Jesus a faaeraeg oaroi meoneoiniuniun Galilee nge a weriir riiurhai pwipwi, Simon me Andrew, iir rhooan fita, rewuug fetaen noan meoneoiniun we.
Iwe, Jesus a aengaeniir pwe, “Oaw itto tapweaei pwe ipwe kapwiung ngaenigaemi wunuunun aaemi oawpwe fita aeremas.”
Iwe rhag nge ra siusaengi wuug kkewe aar nge ra tapweei noa mwirin Jesus.
Ese pwan taaw noa aan faaeraeg nge a pwan weriir riiurhai pwipwi, James me John, ikkiwe naiun Zebedee. Reno wooan pwoot we waar nge refeeori naiiur wuug.
Nge igiwe rhag Jesus a giuneer, a faingiir. Ra siusaengi Zebedee we semeer wooan pwoot we waar me rhooan engaang kkewe nge ra tapweei noa mwirin Jesus.
Erhai Mwaaen Ewartae Aniu Aenneew Wooan
Jesus me rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun ra toori taeninimwen Capernaum. Nge igiwe a toori raaenin Sabbath, Jesus a toonong noan eew wutteer Jews nge a rhaepetae aan fenai.
Iir aeremas kkewe re rongorong ra riutae reen aan fenai, pwe aan fenai ese weei taeppen aar fenai sinsein anniug kkewe, pwe a taeppen erhai eyor maemaewan.
Reen rhag oatowe erhai mwaaen a yor erhai aniu aenneew wooan a toonong noan wutteer Jews we nge a itinong aekkepwas,
“Meeta oamw mwerhaen ngaenigemaem, Jesus re Nazareth? Wa itto pwe wopwe oatoaropagemaem? Ngaang i giuneei een iyo: een mwaaenessoar we rhooan pweipwogin kkepas we aaen Deus!”
Iwe, Jesus a anniugiu ngaeni aniuwe pwe, “Wopwe anniug noa nge wa siunoa me wooan mwaaen na.”
Iwe nge iiy aniu aenneew we a feeori mwaaen we pwe epwe ngoong fetaen, nge a aekkepwas nge a tiwtiw me wooan.
Iwe aeremas towunap ra riutae nge ra rhaepetae aar kkepas nee fineer, “Meeta eei? Pwan eew taeppen fenai ffeo minneei? Mwaaen een eyor maemaewan pwe e iura rhag eew nge aniu aenneew re tapweei.”
Iwe miniwe kkepesaen Jesus a rheeoi mwetekkaei noa wooan Galilee.
Jesus a Aecchipwa Towunepaen Aeremas
Mwirin, Jesus me James me John me rhooan kkayeo kkewe ra noa saengi wutteer Jews we nge ra noa noan imwaen Simon me Andrew.
Iwe niewe inaen pwiuniuwaen Simon e wonon semwaai reen pwerhikkeraen ginin. Etonong rhag Jesus nge ra aengaeni wunuunun niewe.
Iwe, Jesus a toonong reen, a ammwarhiu paiun nge a tipaengitae. Iwe, a saer noa pwerhin niewe iwe a ittae engaang ngaeniir.
Mwirin tupwunoan aenet pwe a nee oatofaaef noa, aeremas ra pweipwog to rhooa semwaai reen Jesus, pwan rhooawe eyor aniu aenneew wooar.
Iwe oanongeer rhooan aepinoamw we ra itto mweoiu noa mesaen iimw we.

Iwe Jesus a aecchipwaar tae towunepeer rhooa semwaai kkewe saengi mesemesaen aar semwaai. A asiiur noa towunepaen aniu aenneew, nge ese fang ngaeniir mwo nge epat pwe repwe aepesa, pwe ra fasiun giuneei iiy iyo.
Jesus a Fenai Noan Galilee
Weni mmwaei raaenin we eraaen, igiwe aenet esaaen teeotae, Jesus a mmasetae nge a toowow me reen iimw we. A noa eew pwiuneoi ne iiy noa rhag nge a noa maeipin e.
Nge Simon me rhooawe rhinan ra noa giutta Jesus.
Oatowe ra weri, ra aengaeni pwe, “Oanongeer aeremas ra giuttoag.”
Nge Jesus a aengaeniir pwe, “Oaw sipwe pwan noa noan aekkaew soapw, pwe ipwe noa fenai e, pwe ina faan aaei itto.”
Iwe a noa noan oanongaen Galilee, a noa fenai noan wutteer Jews we nge a asiiur wow aniu aenneew.
Jesus a Aecchipwa Erhai Mwaaen Maemerhoar
Iwe, erhai mwaaen kaenepaai a itto reen Jesus, a foatotiw me mmwan nge a aeffaenipirhe ngaeni pwe epwe tipaengi. A aepesa pwe, “Aere wo mwerhaen, wa aecchipwanoa aaei semwaai.”
Iwe Jesus a igin faayeow, e angenoa nge a geotteopa mwaaen we, nge a paniuwaeni pwe, “Ngaang i mwerhaen, wone cchipw noa!”
Reen rhag oatowe nge kaenepaai we a rhiuw saengi mwaaen we, iwe a nimegacch noa.
Mwirin, Jesus a igin feneow mwaaen we nge a mwetekkaein aefenganoa,

moannon aan aengaeni pwe, “Pipiiy, wosoapw aengaeni mwo nge erhai minneei, nge wa faaeraeg uwen noa reen patere pwe epwe weriug. Iwe nge a feeori oasoar we Moses e akkiuneo, pwe epwe pwaeri ngaeniir aeremas pwe wa nimegacch noa.”

Nge mwaaen we a noa nge a noa aepesa faaeraegiy wunuunun miniwe a wen ngaeni. Ina faaen Jesus esa mmwenen noa no fenai noan taeninimw kkewe reen. Nge a noa rhag no noan pwiuneoi ne iiy noa rhag. Iwe, aeremas saengi oanongaen pwiuneoi ra itto reen.
